# Vehicle and Motorised Assets
These are modifiable SOP's that can be changed by a Commanding Officer.
##General If a vehicle or other general motorised asset is deployed for any reason, the following regulations apply. - The Commander may override any decisions relating to vehicle or other motorised assets. - Authority over ground vehicles (including tanks, Humvees, APCs, and similar assets) rests with the Vehicle Commander. If no Vehicle Commander is assigned, responsibility defaults to the Engineering Officer. - Authority over air vehicles rests with pilots, followed by the rest of the flight crew if no pilot is assigned. - Anyone may operate APCs, tanks, IFVs, and similar vehicles, provided they are capable of using the vehicle and have permission from either the Vehicle Commander, Engineering Officer or Commander, and so long as operating the vehicle does not breach any deployment SOP. - Synthetics may be utilised as drivers for vehicles that do not possess weapons. - Command staff may utilise vehicles so long as it does not violate their deployment SOP’s.
